name: resolve_airport
description: Convert a city name or airport name to an IATA airport code. Call this for BOTH the departure city and destination city before calling check_flights.

city_name.description: The city or airport name as provided by the caller (e.g. 'Los Angeles', 'LAX', 'New York', 'Heathrow')

name: check_flights
description: Search for available flights between two airports on a given date. Returns up to 3 flight options with airline, flight number, times, and price. Returns NO_FLIGHTS if no routes exist.

origin_iata.description: IATA code for the departure airport (e.g. 'LAX')

destination_iata.description: IATA code for the destination airport (e.g. 'JFK')

name: book_flight
description: Confirm a flight booking after the customer has chosen a flight and provided their details. Returns a confirmation number. Only call this AFTER the customer has verbally confirmed they want to proceed.

flight_id.description: The flight ID from the check_flights result (e.g. 'SKY101')

passenger_name.description: Full legal name of the passenger as it appears on their ID

contact_info.description: US phone number (for SMS) or email address (for email) to send the confirmation to

name: send_confirmation
description: Send the booking confirmation to the customer. Sends SMS if contact_info is a US phone number, or email otherwise. Call this immediately after book_flight succeeds.

confirmation_number.description: The confirmation number returned by book_flight (e.g. 'SKY-4B2XR7')

contact_info.description: US phone number or email address
